item.title: Hakuba & Nozawa Onsen Ski Guide: Nagano's Best Resorts
item.description: Nagano Prefecture hosted the 1998 Winter Olympics and holds the best skiing in all of Honshu. The Northern Japan Alps block moisture-laden air rolling in from the Sea of Japan, wringing it out as snowfall that can reach 10–12 metres per season in the deepest locations. The powder here is genuinely dry — lighter and drier than coastal resorts, owing to the inland elevation — and the resort infrastructure, rebuilt for the 1998 Games and continuously improved, is among the best in Asia.
